movie_title: The Largest Star in the Universe – Size Comparison
introduction:
We created our first app ‘Universe in a Nutshell’, together with Tim Urban of Wait but Why!
Appstore

vocabulary.definition: a point of entry or beginning
vocabulary.example: Once large gas balls pass a certain mass threshold, their core becomes hot enough to ignite.

vocabulary.definition: to fail or end feebly, especially after a promising start
vocabulary.example: Red dwarfs are not very massive stars and sort of fizzle out when they die.
The stellar winds from hypergiants carry away significant amounts of mass from the stars.

vocabulary.definition: something enormous in size or power
vocabulary.example: Red hypergiants are solar system size behemoths that are blowing themselves apart.

vocabulary.definition: able to be seen or noticed
vocabulary.example: The app allows users to explore objects from the smallest to the largest in the observable universe.

vocabulary.definition: to be filled with wonder or astonishment
vocabulary.example: One can marvel at the sheer scale of the universe while using the Universe in a Nutshell app.
